entries.title: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
entries.snippet: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

entries.title: US not 'turning back' on Asia allies, but expects them to boost defence - Hegseth
entries.snippet: The US defense secretary is questioned about US commitment, including further arms deals, at an Asian security summit in Singapore.

entries.title: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
entries.snippet: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

entries.title: Nato and EU condemn Russia after drone hits Romanian residential block
entries.snippet: Romania says the Russian drone was likely hit over Ukraine by its air defences and altered its trajectory.

entries.title: Four more men freed from flooded Laos cave after 10 days
entries.snippet: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

entries.title: Ghana parliament passes anti-LGBTQ+ bill
entries.snippet: Same-sex acts are punishable by jail terms under Ghana's new bill targeting those identifying as gay, lesbian or transgender.

entries.title: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
entries.snippet: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

entries.title: Israel put on UN sexual violence in warzones blacklist for first time
entries.snippet: Israel says it rejects allegations in a new report by the office of the UN secretary general.

entries.title: Exploding rocket casts doubts over Nasa's Moon plans
entries.snippet: Explosion of Blue Origin rocket is a setback for the company and for Nasa's Moon plans.

entries.title: Former US attorney general Pam Bondi defends her handling of Epstein files in congressional probe
entries.snippet: The testimony comes about a month after America's top prosecutor was ousted by US President Donald Trump.

entries.title: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
entries.snippet: Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity" the series is known for.

entries.title: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
entries.snippet: Shi Yongxin is sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery.

entries.title: Eight students arrested in Kenya after suspected deadly school arson attack
entries.snippet: Sixteen pupils died in the fire that ripped through a dormitory while they were asleep.

entries.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
entries.snippet: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

entries.title: Survival before safety for Delhi's poor as temperatures hit 45C
entries.snippet: As temperatures peak, Delhi’s informal workers continue working despite growing health risks.

entries.title: Italy restores lucky testicles on bull mosaic worn down by tourists
entries.snippet: The artwork is the centre of a tradition that involves visitors performing three spins on it for good fortune.

entries.title: Ukraine using AI drones to strike vital convoys supplying Russian troops
entries.snippet: BBC Verify has analysed videos of attacks in occupied Ukraine on Russian trucks carrying ammunition, fuel and food.

entries.title: 'Gifts' from a lover and 'botched' cocaine raids: Police inquiry grips South Africa
entries.snippet: South Africa's Madlanga Commission hears about Brazilian butt lift bribe denials and alleged drug heists.

entries.title: 'Men written by women': How ice hockey romances like Off Campus became TV's hottest new genre
entries.snippet: The Amazon Prime adaptation of Elle Kennedy's ice hockey romance book is an early hit with viewers.

entries.title: After decades risking arrest, South Korea's tattoo artists step into the limelight
entries.snippet: Only licensed doctors were allowed to ink tattoos in Korea - breaking the law could lead to heavy fines or jail.

entries.title: Carcass of Timmy the humpback whale brought to shore in Denmark
entries.snippet: The humpback whale, nicknamed "Timmy" by German media, died following a controversial failed rescue effort. His carcass had been drifting near the Danish shore for two weeks.

entries.title: Opinion: Pope Leo reminds us of the value of our shared humanity
entries.snippet: Pope Leo's first encyclical voices his concerns about technology and AI. The pope cautions about the illusions AI bots can create, and how important actual human relationships are.

entries.title: Colombia's untapped wonder: The Mavecure Mountains
entries.snippet: Far from Colombia's tourist hubs, the Mavecure Mountains rise from the Amazon jungle. Once off-limits during conflict, they now draw adventurous visitors to rare wildlife, sacred sites and vast views.

entries.title: The NTSB tries to keep cockpit audio recordings private. AI is making that harder
entries.snippet: The National Transportation Safety Board temporarily pulled its docket system offline after digital images were used to reconstruct cockpit voice recordings of the pilots in a recent crash.

entries.title: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing takes first foreign tour as leader, with visit to India
entries.snippet: The tour comes as Myanmar's new government tries to consolidate its political position regionally, while continuing to wage a brutal civil war.

entries.title: How single-party primary elections are reshaping Congress
entries.snippet: Some lawmakers are speaking out against closed, single-party primaries, which they see as part of a system that limits voter choice and incentivizes elected officials to prioritize party loyalty.

entries.title: What it means to be a man is a theme in Texas Senate race as Paxton attacks Talarico
entries.snippet: Soon after winning the Texas Republican Senate primary runoff, Ken Paxton attacked Democratic nominee, state Rep. James Talarico as "too low-T for Texas," putting manhood front and center in the race.

entries.title: Trump's name must come off of the Kennedy Center, judge rules
entries.snippet: The judge wrote in his 94-page ruling that it was "crystal clear" that the arts complex was named for the late president John F. Kennedy. He also ruled that the center could not wind down its programming and close for two years of renovations – at least for now

entries.title: Why are people attacking Ebola clinics? It revolves around trust, death and body bags
entries.snippet: In echoes of past outbreaks, community members are attacking clinics, distrusting doctors and following burial traditions that could lead to more cases of Ebola.

entries.title: Louisiana lawmakers pass a congressional map to dismantle a majority-Black district
entries.snippet: Louisiana's Republican lawmakers raced to eliminate one of two majority-Black congressional seats in the state after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled the current map unconstitutional in a sweeping ruling.

entries.title: Bus crashes into cars on Virginia interstate, killing 5 people, state police say
entries.snippet: A bus crashed into vehicles slowing for a work zone on Interstate 95 in Virginia early Friday, killing five people and injuring dozens, including the driver, authorities said.

entries.title: Asia defense summit opens with China and doubts about U.S. priorities topping concerns
entries.snippet: Vietnam's leader said Friday that the Strait of Hormuz has shown how one flashpoint can throw the rest of the world into turmoil, suggesting that the U.S. and China need to abide by international law to avoid provoking a global crisis as they vie for influence in the Asia-Pacific

entries.title: Kenyan court blocks U.S. plan to open Ebola quarantine center to treat Americans

entries.title: How a Blue Origin rocket explosion could impact NASA's moon mission
entries.snippet: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket exploded on the launchpad during a test in Cape Canaveral on Thursday. The company, owned by Jeff Bezos, said no one was injured and all personnel were accounted for. But the rocket has a crucial role in NASA's Artemis program to return American ast

entries.title: Capehart and Continetti on Talarico's chances against Paxton in Texas
entries.snippet: Jonathan Capehart of MS NOW and Wall Street Journal opinion columnist Matthew Continetti join Geoff Bennett to discuss the week in politics, including midterm primary elections showing more signs of strength for President Trump within the GOP, James Talarico's chances against Ken

entries.title: Killing of Israeli embassy workers inspires father to confront rising antisemitism
entries.snippet: One year ago, a gunman approached an event for young diplomats at the Capital Jewish Museum in Washington, D.C., and killed two young employees of Israel's U.S. embassy. Yaron Lischinsky was 30 years old and Sarah Milrim was 26. They were about to become engaged. Yaron's father,

entries.title: 'The Hero Next Door' highlights overlooked sacrifices of service members
entries.snippet: For more than two decades, Martha Raddatz has reported from the front lines of America's wars, bearing witness to courage under unimaginable circumstances. In her new book, the veteran ABC News journalist turns her attention to the service members, families and everyday Americans

entries.title: Mahjong thriving as players embrace community and connection
entries.snippet: Once a pastime viewed by some as old-fashioned, the game of mahjong is having a moment. In recent years, players of all ages have been strategizing and socializing at mahjong tables from coast to coast. Deema Zein reports on the tile game's resurgence.

entries.title: Judge says New Hampshire must loosen proof-of-citizenship rules for voter registration
entries.snippet: A federal judge has said that New Hampshire must make voter registration easier by allowing applicants to attest to their U.S. citizenship if they don't have the documents to prove it.

entries.title: Pancreatic cancer is deadly and difficult to treat. A new pill could change that
entries.snippet: The overall survival rate for people who got daraxonrasib was 13.2 months, nearly double the 6.7 months people survived on standard chemotherapy alone.

entries.title: 3 climbers died, 1 rescued after falling near treacherous pass on Alaska's Mount McKinley
entries.snippet: The four climbers were part of a seven-person Latvian mountaineering expedition traversing a route known for its exposed sections where many injuries and deaths have occurred over the years when they fell Wednesday, the National Park Service has said.

entries.title: Judge says Kennedy Center board violated law putting Trump's name on building, blocks closure
entries.snippet: A federal judge ruled Friday that President Donald Trump's name was illegally added to the Kennedy Center and blocked the administration from closing the cultural and arts venue for major renovations.

entries.title: Louisiana passes new congressional map to eliminate majority-Black district, give GOP another seat
entries.snippet: Approval of the new House map came a month after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down the state's current map as an illegal racial gerrymander, weakening the landmark 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.

entries.title: WATCH: Bondi refused to answer any questions about Trump and Epstein files, Rep. Garcia says
entries.snippet: Pam Bondi was on Capitol Hill for a closed-door interview in which she defended the administration's actions before House lawmakers who are scrutinizing a process that was delayed and included personal information of potential victims.

entries.title: WATCH: Epstein survivors press Comer to interview Bondi under oath, ask about release of files
entries.snippet: Several survivors of Epstein's abuse appeared outside the House office room where the interview happened behind closed doors. They pressed the committee chair, Republican Rep. James Comer, to closely question Bondi.

entries.title: With a stalemate in Ukraine and discontent at home, Putin seems ready to escalate his war
entries.snippet: Russia's warning to carry out "consistent and systematic" missile strikes on Kyiv, accompanied by a call for evacuating foreign embassies from the capital, signals Vladimir Putin's intention to expand Russia's barrage despite the heavy costs and potential international outrage.

entries.title: Devastating wildfire and homelessness loom over Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass' bid for second term
entries.snippet: As Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass seeks a second term, she isn't sidestepping the obvious: her tenure at city hall has been difficult. "I haven't always got it right," she says plainly.

entries.title: Israeli and Russian forces added to UN blacklist for sexual violence in conflict zones
entries.snippet: An annual United Nations report documenting sexual violence in conflicts worldwide has included Israeli forces for the first time since the review began more than 15 years ago for their treatment of Palestinian detainees. Israel denies the accusations.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: What Hungary must do to receive EU funds frozen under Orban
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Peter Magyar and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced a deal that could free up over €16 billion in EU funds for Hungary. Now, Magyar's new government needs to deliver.

entries.title: Laos: Five people rescued from flooded cave
entries.snippet: Seven people who entered the cave last week were trapped inside by flash flooding that blocked their way. Five of them found some days ago have been freed after rescuers pumped water out of the cave system.

entries.title: Russia recalls Armenia ambassador over EU ties
entries.snippet: The recall comes a day after Putin warned Armenia against seeking EU membership and alluded to the "Ukrainian scenario." Armenia historically has strong ties with Russia but has pivoted toward the West in recent years.

entries.title: Malta votes in snap parliamentary election
entries.snippet: Voting is underway in Malta's parliamentary election. Opinion polls show Prime Minister Robert Abela on course for reelection in the shadow of the Middle East crisis.

entries.title: Germany news: Chaos possible as demo blocks Alpine pass
entries.snippet: A demonstration is planned at a major pass through the Alps, with huge traffic disruption possible. And a German minister is looking to crack down on screen time for kids. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: Myanmar president arrives to boost ties
entries.snippet: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing is on a five-day visit to India, where he will hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Meanwhile, Karnataka is readying itself for a Cabinet change. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Iran war: US says ready to resume war if no deal reached
entries.snippet: The United States is "more than capable" of resuming a war with Iran after President Donald Trump said a touted peace deal must include his red lines. Iran has denied that there is a final agreement. DW has more.

entries.title: International aid cuts complicate Congo's Ebola epidemic
entries.snippet: The scaling back of development aid has contributed to the inability to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. German organizations are calling for a major spending boost to help stop the spread.

entries.title: Three Latvian mountaineers die on North America's tallest peak
entries.snippet: Three climbers fell to their deaths near a perilous pass on Mount McKinley in the US's Denali National Park and Preserve. One mountaineer was rescued.

entries.title: Shangri-La Dialogue: Hegseth says 'no state, including China,' must dominate Asia
entries.snippet: US Defense Secretary of Pete Hegseth expressed alarm about China's military buildup in Asia. He also said the United States expects its allies and partners in Asia to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.

entries.title: Top US and Cuban generals meet at Guantanamo Bay
entries.snippet: Amid the deterioration of relations between the United States and Cuba, a top US general held a rare meeting with senior Cuban military officials at Guantanamo Bay.

entries.title: US: Judge rules Trump name must be removed from Kennedy Center
entries.snippet: Trump criticized the ruling, saying the judge "should be ashamed of himself," but will hand the venue over to Congress.

entries.title: Ghana approves law criminalizing LGBTQ+ activities, advocacy
entries.snippet: Ghana's Parliament passed one of the most repressive anti-LGBTQ+ laws in Africa. The law imposes prison terms on individuals who "promote" LGBTQ+ activities.

entries.title: Romania's political crisis deepens
entries.snippet: After Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan’s government fell in early May, Romania's moderate parties have struggled to chart a new course — opening the door for the far right to gain ground.

entries.title: Romania: Russian drone strikes Galati apartment building
entries.snippet: Romania accused Russia of a "grave and irresponsible escalation" after a Russian drone entered its airspace. German Chancellor Merz said "we need a strong NATO presence on the eastern flank" after the incident.

entries.title: US judge halts Trump's 'anti-weaponization' fund
entries.snippet: The billion-dollar "anti-weaponization" fund was meant to compensate people who Trump sees as victims of so-called "lawfare" by Joe Biden's administration.

entries.title: EU unblocks €16 billion in Hungary assistance as Magyar promises reforms
entries.snippet: Reforms under new Prime Minister Peter Magyar will enable the EU to free up billions in frozen assistance for Budapest. The EU's Ursula von der Leyen announced the news as Magyar visited Brussels.

entries.title: Netherlands allows Kanye West to perform despite protests
entries.snippet: US rapper Kanye West will be allowed to perform in the Netherlands despite Dutch lawmakers and Jewish activists seeking to ban him from the EU country over multiple antisemitic scandals.

entries.title: Ethiopia election 2026: Tigray excluded and on edge
entries.snippet: As Ethiopia is heading to the polls, the Tigray region won't be participating in the vote for the second time, with tensions simmering on. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and his Prosperity Party meanwhile are expected to win.
